# JayCee Trading & Services

> Food distribution partner in Puerto Princesa, Palawan. Supplies meats, seafood, dairy, frozen goods and imported groceries to homes, hotels, restaurants and businesses across Palawan since 2017.

## Business facts

- Business name: JayCee Trading & Services
- Address: Zone 2, Abanico Rd, Puerto Princesa City, Palawan, Philippines
- Phone and WhatsApp: +63 977 116 7555
- Email: tradingjaycee@gmail.com
- Location: https://share.google/flXVdOZwopX2RWgnM
- Facebook: https://web.facebook.com/jayceetrading
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jayceetradingservices/
- Service area: Puerto Princesa, Roxas, San Vicente, Taytay, El Nido, Palawan
- Currency: Philippine peso (PHP)
- Ordering: online with pickup or delivery
- Payment methods: GCash, PHQR, bank transfer, cash on delivery, cash on pickup

## What we supply

- Meats and poultry: beef cuts, pork, chicken, sausages and cold cuts
- Seafood: shrimp, salmon and crabstick
- Dairy: cheese, butter, cream, yogurt and milk
- Frozen and imported groceries for restaurants, hotels, canteens and homes
